label: preparing
what: A confidential gathering in the great hall at eighteen hundred, organized by the innkeeper with builder and freight helping. Refreshments are privately funded, bread and grain are being sought, and the builder installed eight lanterns free. Secretary knowingly assists with reservation and escort; baker and neighbour appear to help with baking, though their knowledge of the gathering is unconfirmed. It may celebrate my forty years of service, but that purpose has not been confirmed.
